name: Sewer Pipeline Kitchen Home Toilet Drain Cleaning Narrow Bendable Curve Grabber Tools
description:
Material: Durable plastic & metal

Size: 60 cm long reach

Design: Narrow, bendable, and curved for hard-to-reach areas

Function: Long reach claw pick-up tool for home, kitchen, toilet, and drain cleaning

Claw Action: Four strong claw ends controlled by a spring-loaded grip; opens and closes with handle for precise grabbing

Versatile: Picks up magnetic and non-magnetic parts, screws, bolts, and small objects from restricted areas

Operation: Two-finger action; squeeze handle to open claws, release to grip the item

Description:
Retrieve small objects from tight spaces with this 60 cm long sewer pipeline and drain cleaning grabber tool. Its bendable and narrow design makes it perfect for reaching dropped screws, bolts, or debris in kitchens, bathrooms, and drains. Controlled by a spring-loaded handle, the four-claw end ensures a secure grip on both magnetic and non-magnetic parts. Durable, versatile, and handy, it’s a must-have tool for every household.
